title: Open Claim-Line Reconsideration Hold on Facility Lapses, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
When a Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Select lapses under **Referrals and Authorizations**, a reconsideration hold applies while a case about one of the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines may still change the days a line carries.

## Record read

The patient's most recent case in **Appeals and Grievances** (the latest by filing date) whose subject is a claim line under TRICARE Select, with its status and its filing date.

## Rule

1. Where that case is filed or under review and was filed no more than thirty days ago, **1 day** is held.
2. Where it is filed or under review and was filed more than thirty days ago, **2 days** are held.
3. Otherwise nothing is held.

## Judgement table

| Status of the most recent such case | Filed | Days held |
|---|---|---|
| filed, or under review | 30 days ago or less | 1 |
| filed, or under review | more than 30 days ago | 2 |
| any other status | any | 0 |
| no such case | not applicable | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

A case under review filed exactly 30 days ago holds 1 day; the same case on the next day, filed 31 days ago, holds 2 days.
